sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Thermoforming and Automated Trimming of Multilayer Aligners

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation with French civil law and customary law influences)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) – active regional FTA
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement – active sub-regional FTA
No active comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTAA) with major G-20 economies; Vanuatu maintains territorial/zero-tax policy for International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 160] as amended; International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 35]; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2015 (as amended); VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines and UBO Register Maintenance Directions issued thereunder.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each ultimate beneficial owner's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or Commissioner for Oaths in the document's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement, issued within last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming the UBO's identity and banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Association / Constitution of the International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by registered agent and filing with VFSC

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Consent to act as director and secretary, including corporate undertaking forms
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization or witnessed execution before the registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, secretaries and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UK HMT sanctions list, and Vanuatu domestic enforcement notices. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation, and senior management approval. Screening must be completed before incorporation and refreshed annually or upon any ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry online portal at vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be expressed in Latin (Roman) script. The name may be in English, French, or Bislama but must transliterate non-Latin scripts into Latin characters. The name must end with a statutory suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Société Anonyme', or 'S.A.' and may not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or reserved name in the VFSC registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection notice issued by the VFSC, the applicant or licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Companies Registry within 14 days from the date of rejection, stating the grounds for distinguishing the proposed name from cited conflicting names and attaching any supporting consents or trademark registrations. If the VFSC maintains the rejection, the applicant may make a ministerial appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services or re-submit a fresh name reservation application with a modified name. A name reservation may benefit from one extension request submitted before expiry, subject to VFSC discretion and payment of the applicable extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted in law with structural limits: the International Company must at all times maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu. The registered agent's address may serve as the registered office and can function as a 'virtual' commercial address for a non-resident, zero-tax digital business. No physical inventory or staff need be present in Vanuatu for the dental aligner sheet commercial model, which consists of cloud-based design, platform card payment collection, and overseas thermoforming production. However, the registered office address cannot be used for licensable local activities, such as physical banking, insurance, or trust business, without separate VFSC authorization.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (~1-5% annual likelihood) for a tax-exempt International Company with no local operating footprint. VFSC inspection priorities center on licensed financial institutions, trust and company service providers, and entities creating material on-island regulatory risk. A zero-tax holding and payment-collection vehicle in the dental device supply chain is unlikely to trigger an unannounced physical inspection, though documentary compliance audits remain possible.

Government filing fee for incorporation and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
Registered agent and registered office service for the first year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard-risk corporate structures

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and issuing authorities in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for notary and apostille service bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of International Company constitutional documents and corporate resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent / legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard IC incorporation document package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 2011, sections 5-12 (incorporation procedures), section 34 (registered office), section 40 (registered agent); Business Licence Act [Cap 242] as residual commercial licensing law
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) submitted with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, leading to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; the initial share subscription may be satisfied by issuing one or more shares at par value without any escrow or capital deposit requirement
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscription to ordinary shares set forth in the share subscription schedule be and is hereby accepted, and the directors are authorized to allot the subscribed shares upon payment of the agreed consideration. RESOLVED that the registered office at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu be adopted as the company's official seat, and the registered agent be instructed to file all requisite notices with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED that the persons named in the officer schedule be appointed as director, managing director, and secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED that the managing director be authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and transact business in the company's name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Pre-Filing Legal Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Division, online registry e-portal, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed name-reservation annex and a name availability search request via the VFSC online registry portal through the licensed registered agent; verify that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing or reserved name and does not imply government sponsorship or a prohibited activity under the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport pages of intended directors
Written consent to proposed name from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, file up to two alternate names within five business days; the VFSC will review the alternates within 48 hours without an additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the International Companies Act 2011; VFSC Pre-Registration Review Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage the licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in full conformity with the Act, including the ISIC 3250 thermoforming object clause, share allotment provisions, and officer indemnity language; arrange notarial attestation of subscriber and first director signatures before a Vanuatu notary public or a consular officer.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC Pre-Registration Review returns drafting comments, revise and resubmit the instruments within seven business days; any objection to the object clause is cured by adding a permitted-objects provision expressly endorsed by the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application File to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry, electronic document lodgement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC-1 together with the certified Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered agent's consent and undertaking, particulars of directors and officers, and the statutory declaration of compliance; identify in the cover letter that no minimum paid-up capital applies and state the proposed share denomination and initial issued share count.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association
Form IC-2 (Particulars of Directors and Officers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On issuance of a VFSC query notice, file a corrective statement within fourteen calendar days; failure to cure results in deemed withdrawal of the application with a partial refund of 75% of the filing fee, whereupon the file may be re-lodged as a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Division and E-Payment Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Remit the USD 300 incorporation fee through the registered agent's payment instruction and obtain the VFSC stamped invoice confirmation; upon VFSC endorsement, download the Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies, and record the incorporation date and national registration number in the company's permanent register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any discrepancy in the Certificate of Incorporation is corrected ex parte by the VFSC upon written request accompanied by the original certificate, with re-issuance completed within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Registered Agent Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent, Port Vila registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered office services agreement designating the physical address in Port Vila and file the registered office address notice with the VFSC Registry; the registered agent assumes custody of the company seal, minute book, share register, and statutory records, and signs the custody schedule.
required_dossiers: Company seal and records custody schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office notice is rejected for insufficient address particulars, supply the precise GPS and unit references and re-notify the Registry within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Opening of Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors with Company Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting by physical or electronic attendance, adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, approve the allotment of the subscribed ordinary shares, open the register of members, directors, and secretary, issue share certificates, and instruct the registered agent to maintain the minutes at the registered office.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution signed in duplicate
Register of directors, officers, and members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any irregular share allotment is ratified by a subsequent board resolution; defective share certificates are surrendered and re-issued within five business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in coordination with the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Manufacturing and Processing (Dental Clear Aligner Thermoforming) issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap 242]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Port Vila
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Preliminary Environmental Assessment / Registration screening (Schedule 2 light-industrial category); a Full EIA Report is not required where installed thermoforming polymer input remains below five tonnes per month
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Waste Management Act No. 35 of 2018 and associated regulations; wastewater discharges limited to permit thresholds for suspended solids and pH 6-9; particulate and VOC emissions bounded by Clean Air screening levels; all polymer offcuts segregated and dispatched to DEPC-approved recyclers with disposal manifests retained for five years

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services covering heat-press and vacuum-forming equipment; structural load inspection certificate from the Public Works Department verifying floor loading for thermoforming machines; occupational workplace clearance from the Labour Department under the National Occupational Health and Safety Policy covering machine guarding, ventilation, and personal protective equipment standards

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Office of the Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] through a licensed registered agent and obtain the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation; 2) file a TIN Application form with the VRC accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered agent consent letter, and AML-compliant copies of beneficial owner passports and proof of address; 3) the VRC issues a non-VAT TIN to the IC; 4) a separate VAT registration number is required only if the IC makes domestic taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding VT 5,000,000 per 12-month period, in which case registration must be effected within 21 days of the obligation date. Offshore export receipts create no domestic VAT nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu imposes no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax, and recognizes no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections for International Companies; the IC is mandatorily treated as a tax-exempt offshore entity under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 250]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 compulsory registration threshold (VT 1,000,000 voluntary threshold) for domestic taxable turnover in any 12-month period; wholly offshore International Companies fall outside the charge to VAT
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance API, or digital stamping mandate. Vanuatu operates a manual/PDF tax invoice regime; a valid VAT invoice under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 250] may be issued on paper or in standard PDF format without filing with VRC before issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating (0% VAT) applies where dental clear aligner sheets are sold to a non-resident customer, the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within 30 days of supply, title and risk pass outside Vanuatu, and payment is received in foreign currency from non-Vanuatu sources. Offshore services qualify only if the recipient is non-resident and the service benefit is located wholly outside Vanuatu.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC audits match the Customs Export Declaration date, the Bill of Lading journey, and the Inward Remittance Certificate; any missing or inconsistent document triggers reversal of the zero-rated refund, a default assessment, and interest. Knowingly false export-refund claims expose the exporter to retrospective clawback of the refunded amount, a civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded, and on conviction a fine or imprisonment (Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 250], ss. 25-34). The limitation period is open-ended for fraud or wilful default. Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark is the expedient evidentiary safe harbor for refund substantiation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 292], acting as the central bank and monetary authority; the Minister of Finance retains residual exchange-control powers, while the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers licensing and AML/CFT supervision under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 70] and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 282].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current-account transactions without balance-of-payments restrictions, and Vanuatu maintains a liberalised offshore regime: capital-account convertibility is also available to non-resident International Companies (ICs), with unrestricted profit and capital repatriation subject only to standard documentary verification of source of funds and beneficial ownership. Practical liquidity constraints exist because VUV is a low-volume offshore currency; therefore cross-border treasury operations are typically denominated in USD, AUD, NZD or EUR. Remittance hurdles are minimal but banks retain discretionary compliance screening under AML/CTF rules and correspondent-bank due-diligence policies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio apply to export proceeds in Vanuatu. Under the liberalised exchange-control framework and the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], an IC may retain and deploy 100% of foreign-currency receipts in multi-currency onshore or offshore accounts without any surrender obligation or conversion deadline. The only requirements are transaction-level record-keeping and submission of supporting commercial documents (customs entries, shipping bills, packing lists and purchase orders) to the collecting bank for verification and audit trail purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium viability. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, and cross-border payment aggregators) may offer convenient USD/EUR settlement rails, but they cannot be passport-licensed into Vanuatu and would require supplementary local authorisation under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 70] as a Category A or B financial dealer. The IC should treat an offshore EMI strictly as a secondary collections channel for platform credit-card and Stripe flows, with the primary treasury account held at a Vanuatu-licensed commercial bank to avoid regulatory ambiguity, settlement delays and AML concentration risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Vanuatu-licensed banks generally mandate a physical appearance of at least one director and all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) for an in-person KYC interview, or alternatively permit remote opening via notarised certified documents combined with a bank-conducted video conference where the bank's correspondent-bank policies allow. Practical mandate: original passport, proof of residential address, source-of-wealth documentation and a certified copy of the VFSC agent-issued certificate of incumbency are required; a physical visit to Port Vila is strongly recommended to avoid 4-to-6-week delays arising from correspondent-bank sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence on IC structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act using nominee shareholders or directors without transparent UBO disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC agent-issued certificate of incumbency, full register of directors and shareholders, written nominee declarations identifying each natural-person UBO, an organisational-chart narrative establishing economic substance, and an independent PEP/sanctions enhanced due-diligence report from a licensed compliance provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border dental-aligner trade involving contract manufacturing, platform disbursements (Stripe/credit-card) and multi-jurisdiction distributors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed manufacturing and distribution agreements, proforma invoices showing clear unit economics, shipping and customs records for ISIC 3250 thermoformed multilayer aligner sheets, and an AML risk-tier narrative classifying the business as Low_Risk_Standard with defined transactional velocity limits and expected monthly settlement volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from shareholders and outbound trade settlements lacking transparent purpose codes or supporting trade documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital escrow agreement, board resolution authorising treasury execution, chargeable equity contribution certificate, source-of-wealth evidence (bank statements and audited financials from the subscriber), and a purpose-code mapping schedule aligning every outbound SWIFT instruction to the underlying commercial invoice, packing list and bill of lading.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing via SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer from the beneficial owner's high-street bank, quoting in field 70/72 the ISO 20022 purpose code for equity capital / direct investment in an International Company, with pre-notification to the Vanuatu receiving bank (ANZ or BSP preferred) attaching the certified certificate of incorporation, current certificate of good standing, beneficial-ownership register and a treasury instruction letter. The funds are credited to a dedicated Capital Escrow Account and released to the operational account only after bank compliance clearance, including completion of source-of-funds verification against the ISIC 3250 aligner-sheet business plan.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 transfers for supplier down-payments, intra-group licensing fees and distributor refunds; (2) documentary Letters of Credit (UCP600) and standby LCs issued through ANZ or BSP Vanuatu for thermoforming equipment and polymer raw-material purchases; (3) documentary collections (DP/DA) for low-risk repeat shipments of finished aligner sheets; and (4) USD/AUD cross-border clearing through global correspondent banks. Every outbound payment must be matched to the underlying invoice, packing list, bill of lading and approved vendor record to prevent FTRA reporting failures and correspondent-bank OFAC false-positive holds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore outright forward contracts (USD/VUV and USD/AUD) executed through ANZ Vanuatu or BRED Bank as authorised dealers, priced on an RBV reference rate with approximately 2-4 pips spread and 10% margin collateral

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/VUV cleared through Hong Kong or Singapore dealing desks, referencing the RBV official mid-rate, permissible where onshore VUV liquidity is insufficient for physical delivery
Cross-currency swaps (USD/AUD and USD/EUR) with international investment-bank counterparties to term-match equipment-financing and raw-material procurement exposure
Vanilla FX options and zero-cost collar structures on USD/AUD to hedge the conversion of aligner export receivables into operating currency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Fee (International Company Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the last day of the month of incorporation anniversary; a 30-day late-filing window is available if the registered agent files a late notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a penalty plus additional monthly surcharge; non-payment for six consecutive months subjects the International Company to administrative strike-off and dissolution by VFSC, after which restoration requires a formal application and payment of all outstanding fees and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Register of Members, Register of Directors and Beneficial Ownership Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (maintained at the registered office and available for VFSC inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No fixed annual filing date; updates must be recorded immediately upon any share transfer, director change, or beneficial ownership event. Notifications to VFSC for changes in registered details are due within 30 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or update statutory registers constitutes a compliance breach and may result in VFSC administrative fines, an order for rectification, and ultimately strike-off if the company repeatedly fails to comply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent and company records (not filed with VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ongoing obligation; accounting records and underlying transaction documents must be retained for a minimum of seven years from the date of each transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-retention of required records is a criminal offence under the International Companies Act and may result in director disqualification, monetary penalties, and corporate suspension.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard International Company; Vanuatu ICs are exempt from compulsory statutory audit and from filing financial statements with VFSC. An audit becomes compulsory only if the company engages in separately regulated financial services requiring a VFSC licence, such as banking, insurance, or securities dealing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No accounting framework is prescribed for International Companies. If financial statements are voluntarily prepared, the prevailing standard is IFRS. Additional regulated licences in Vanuatu require adherence to IFRS and any applicable VFSC license conditions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu does not require a standalone annual UBO confirmation form for International Companies. The licensed registered agent must verify and record the beneficial ownership of every member at the time of formation, immediately upon any share transfer, and whenever the UBO register changes. Records of UBO and share transfers must remain current at the registered office for lawful inspection and VFSC information requests.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,500 typical annual fee per licensed Vanuatu registered agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary audit typically USD 3,000 – USD 6,000 depending on transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax. International Companies (ICs) incorporated under the International Companies Act are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu direct taxes on profits, capital gains, and distributions. Effective tax rate on worldwide business income is 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return for International Companies (IC Compliance Filing) submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Portal (VOIS) or the appointed VFSC-licensed Registered Agent. No corporate income tax return or revenue form is required because Vanuatu imposes no CIT.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six months after the anniversary of incorporation or by the date specified in the VFSC renewal notice. The filing is a compliance maintenance obligation rather than a tax assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, International Company registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors are permitted. Enter exact VFSC-registered particulars; do not list a foreign registered office in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part B – Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical address of the VFSC-licensed registered agent and the IC's registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Appoint and confirm a local VFSC-licensed agent. A P.O. Box alone is not accepted as a registered office address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C – Tax Exemption and Business Activities Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC is not carrying on business with any person resident in Vanuatu and is not earning Vanuatu-source assessable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain supporting export invoices, thermoforming supply contracts, and shipping documentation to substantiate that the dental aligner sheets are manufactured and sold outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D – Directors, Shareholders, and Ultimate Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors, members, and ultimate beneficial owners including full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident participants must submit passport copies, proof of address, and a tax residence declaration. Certified translations must be provided where documents are not in English.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E – Economic Substance Statement (if applicable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC is conducting any relevant activity under Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations, including headquarters, distribution, IP holding, financing, banking, insurance, or shipping.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a dental clear aligner sheet operation, disclose whether the core manufacturing and trimming activities are physically performed outside Vanuatu. If the IC merely holds IP or centralizes procurement, verify whether the IP-asset relevant activity category applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission triggers VFSC late filing penalties and daily surcharges on unpaid annual government fees. The VFSC may withhold the Certificate of Good Standing, impose fines for false declarations, and ultimately strike the IC off the register. Continued default may result in dissolution without limitation of director liability for post-strike-off trading.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not required for Vanuatu-source distributions because Vanuatu does not impose withholding tax on dividends or any other income paid to non-residents. Vanuatu is not a party to a comprehensive double tax treaty network; therefore, no TRC-based treaty relief is available or necessary for IC dividends. If a foreign tax authority requires proof of Vanuatu corporate status, the VFSC Registration Certificate and Incumbency Certificate serve as evidentiary documents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate for cross-border IP royalties and debt interest is 0%. No DTA rate applies because Vanuatu levies no source-based income tax on royalty or interest payments made by an IC to non-residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold expressed in Vanuatu Vatu. Vanuatu currently imposes no transfer pricing documentation rules due to the absence of corporate income tax. Nevertheless, ICs engaged in relevant activities under the Economic Substance Regulations must maintain contemporaneous records evidencing core income-generating activities, physical presence, adequate employees, and board management in Vanuatu. A de facto documentation expectation applies irrespective of turnover for entities claiming substance-based exemptions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's International Companies (Economic Substance) Act and supporting ESR require ICs undertaking relevant activities to satisfy real economic presence such as physical office, local employees, board meetings in Vanuatu, and decisions made in Vanuatu. The dental clear aligner sheet manufacture under ISIC 3250 may fall outside the classic pure holding or IP high-risk categories if the IC executes real operations overseas; however, any distribution, procurement, or IP-holding arrangement integrated with the IC must be assessed to avoid the shell company classification. ICs must file an annual economic substance statement with the VFSC where a relevant activity is identified.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Tax-Exemption Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately misrepresenting an International Company's activities as fully tax-exempt when the entity is in fact carrying on business in Vanuatu or earning income through a foreign agency arrangement attributable to Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the International Companies Act and Vanuatu criminal law; monetary penalties, deregistration, confiscation of proceeds, and nullification of the tax exemption. The entity may also be retrospectively disqualified from IC status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for civil restitution, disgorgement of profits, travel bans, and imprisonment for fraud where the corporate veil is pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an IC with no employees, premises, or decision-making presence in Vanuatu while undertaking distribution, procurement, or IP-licensing functions through foreign affiliates solely to exploit the zero-tax regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Economic Substance Regulations; VFSC-imposed penalties, possible strike-off, and a foreign tax authority may reclassify the entity as taxable in the actual management jurisdiction with back taxes, interest, and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for outstanding penalties and foreign-imposed taxes if the IC is determined to be a newly incorporated shell; personal asset freezes and travel bans may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering / Counter-Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) Failures
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using payment rails, such as Stripe or PayPal, to collect customer deposits for dental aligner sheets without implementing beneficial ownership identification, KYC checks, sanction screening, or transaction monitoring. Additional red flag: accepting payments from healthcare reimbursement fraud or processing third-party transactions on behalf of undisclosed principals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of Vanuatu's AML/CFT legal framework and Financial Intelligence Unit directives; monetary penalties, suspension of the entity's registration, seizure of suspicious proceeds, and referral for criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individuals knowingly involved in laundering proceeds face imprisonment, fines, travel restrictions, and confiscation of personal assets. Directors cannot rely on the IC's corporate form to shield personal criminal conduct.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Maintain Beneficial Ownership Information
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting to file or update the register of directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners, particularly where foreign clinicians, medical device distributors, or investment funds hold indirect interests through layered entities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC daily default fines, refusal to issue a Certificate of Good Standing, and administrative strike-off. Non-compliance undermines the company's ability to bank, renew licenses, and execute cross-border contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and registered agents are personally subject to fines and may be disqualified from acting as officers of any Vanuatu international company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Local Trading / False Local Business Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting domestic sales of dental clear aligner sheets to dental clinics or end-users resident in Vanuatu, maintaining a local physical inventory or service facility, or performing any act that constitutes carrying on business in Vanuatu in violation of the International Company's non-resident operational restriction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of IC status, monetary penalties, loss of all statutory tax exemptions, and retrospective liability. The VFSC may order deregistration and refer criminal violations to the Public Prosecutor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order or knowingly permit prohibited local dealings are personally liable for unpaid government fees, fines, and third-party claims; the corporate veil is pierced and the directors may be imprisoned.
